result_summary.title: Report Builder Export Issues: Duplicates and Truncation
result_summary.description:
We are experiencing two distinct issues with our scheduled reports in the ANZ production environment. 

1. Duplicate Records: Approximately 15% of the rows in the 'Monthly Sales' report contain exact duplicate entries. 
2. Truncated Files: Several large CSV exports are cutting off mid-file, resulting in incomplete data for about 50 users. 

This is blocking our financial reconciliation for roughly 700 people. Please advise on a fix ASAP.
